files.name: Example1_MedicinalChemistry.ipynb
files.role: medicinal-chemistry walkthrough; checksum locally verified through scoped egress

cohort_selector.rule: Include every experiment mechanically generated by DiversificationPlanner from every replication outcome whose data record contains REPLICATED crossed with every diversification reagent in the frozen input CSV. Do not select by target number, NMR appearance, paper outcome, or later crystallographic status.
code_basis: identification_diversification_experiments selects every replication record containing REPLICATED
urea_product_finder maps all such replicated precursors
populate_experiment_dictionary takes the product of every input reagent code with all replicated precursor products
generate_nmr_dict emits an NMR acquisition record for every generated diversification experiment
update_masses_for_diversification emits expected MS values for every generated diversification experiment
cohort_selector.membership_receipt: DATA.zip central-directory index: NMR .dx IDs and LCMS .raw top-level IDs independently match exactly on the same ten members; no spectrum bytes were read to establish membership.
cohort_selector.membership_freeze_condition: SATISFIED before opening any target-specific raw spectrum.

policy_coupling_receipt.walkthrough_cell_19: Late-stage diversification identifies products by UPLC-MS; low-field NMR is recorded for future reference but no decisions are taken from it.

information_cuts.R0: Original diversification policy-coupled evidence only: intended sample chemistry, expected MS adduct masses, processed UPLC-MS summary and MS_PASS standing. Low-field NMR was physically acquired and retained but explicitly excluded from diversification decisions, so all NMR is withheld at R0.
information_cuts.R1: Reveal retained low-field NMR for the same complete cohort through the same blinded IDs; no high-resolution characterization or XRD.
information_cuts.R2: After a participant commits a claim challenge and orthogonal-characterization rationale, reveal only pre-frozen additional characterization artifacts available for that blinded cohort member.

guards: cohort selection precedes target-specific raw inspection
target 13 alone is never the cohort
R1 retained NMR can support claim challenge without implying exact alternative identification
R2 reveal is conditional on a pre-reveal request and does not retroactively alter R1 standing
UPLC/MS same-mass ambiguity is not treated as absence of all old-interface information because NMR was already retained
